summary: Iteration 12: tested Settings side-menu redesign, raffle jokers (Coringa N), public /trevo page + replay, GET /api/public/raffle masking, Financeiro clover filter/badges, renewal_success clover vars, and the Pay page 'ver sorteio' link. New pytest file has 7/7 passing, and the iter11 + phone/raffle regression has 18/18 passing. All draws were mocked. Found 1 CRITICAL bug: /trevo sent anonymous visitors to /login. I fixed it in lib/api.js. All UI features work once that fix is in. Cleanup done: no TEST_ payments in SQLite or Mongo, no raffle_draws docs, raffle_enabled=false, joker_count=0, joker_phone and joker_login empty, painel_refresh_interval_seconds back to 300.

minor.issue: Only process_paid (payments.py ~L1117) passes {clovers}/{clover_coupons}. Three other call sites do not: the extra-renewal path (payments.py ~L97), manual resend (payments.py ~L1447) and services/renewal_retry.py ~L115. notifier.render leaves unknown placeholders as they are, so if the admin adds {clovers} or {clover_coupons} to the template, customers on those paths get the literal text '{clovers}'. Fix: spread **(await _clover_vars(payment)) at all of them (use '' or 0 for extra logins).

Entries are grouped by customer_id. When raffle_joker_login is set, every joker gets customer_id=joker_login, so 'Coringa 1..N' merge into one row named 'Coringa 1' that holds N coupons. Fix: group jokers by coupon or by 'coringa-i'.

ui_bugs.issue: FIXED BY TESTER: anonymous visitors on /trevo were redirected to /login. App.js calls GET /api/settings on startup, it returns 401, and the interceptor only whitelisted /login, /teste and /pay/. I added /trevo to the whitelist. Better long-term fix: skip the admin settings fetch on public routes.

Uses new Date(draw_at).toLocaleString('pt-BR') with the browser's own timezone. A UTC browser shows '31/10/2026, 23:00' while admin /sorteio shows '31/10/2026 20h'. Pass timeZone: 'America/Sao_Paulo' (or the display tz from the API) so every visitor sees the same time.
The data-testid 'flow-chip-dedup_window_minutes' appears on 2 chips (in 2 different cards).

issues: The clover add-on starts pre-selected with 1 clover (PublicPay.jsx L106). Customers must opt out of a paid extra, which is a consumer-protection risk under the Brazilian CDC. Confirm this is intended.
Observation only: payment-accounts is empty ('nenhuma'), infinitepay_handle is empty and the provider is unselected in this preview DB. Probably environment data, not a code bug.

action_items: Keep the /trevo whitelist fix in lib/api.js, and ideally skip the admin settings fetch in App.js for public routes (/trevo, /teste, /pay)
Pass the clovers/clover_coupons vars in every renewal_success send_notification call (extra renewal, manual resend, renewal_retry)
Show the public draw time in the display timezone
Make joker entry grouping in GET /api/raffle unique per joker when joker_login is set
Fix the duplicate flow-chip data-testid; Settings.jsx is 781 lines (>700), so split it into section components
critical_code_review_comments: lib/api.js: the hard-coded public-path whitelist is fragile; derive it from a shared PUBLIC_ROUTES constant used by both App.js and the interceptor
notifier.render leaves unknown {vars} as they are; consider removing unrendered known template vars
raffle.coupons_for_payment calls entries() for the current month only. A payment paid on the last day but renewed or notified after midnight would get empty coupons. Minor edge case.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested flows after the /trevo fix (90% before)

seed_data_creation: Temporary only, all removed: TEST_ payments in SQLite (also checked in Mongo), a fake Mongo raffle_draws doc _id=2000-01 used for the replay UI, raffle joker settings, and a painel_refresh_interval change 300->301->300.
context_for_next_testing_agent: PRODUCTION env. Run with -n 0: pytest tests/test_raffle_iter12.py tests/test_raffle_iter11.py tests/test_phone_br_and_raffle.py -n 0. For the replay UI, use 'python tests/raffle_fake_history.py add|del' (_id 2000-01). For Financeiro clover rows, use 'python tests/temp_clover_payment.py add|del' (cleans SQLite and Mongo). PublicRaffle history testids start at index 1 (trevo-replay-1). Settings save button is btn-save-settings; with no changes it shows the toast 'Nenhuma alteração'. Never click 'Ir para pagamento'.
rca of the issue: /trevo login redirect: App.js runs settingsApi.get() (an admin-only endpoint) on mount for every route. For anonymous users it returns 401, and the axios interceptor in lib/api.js then sets window.location to /login unless the path starts with /login, /teste or /pay/. /trevo was missing from that list. Mitigation applied: added /trevo to the list. Reproduce: open /trevo in a fresh browser with no wf_token.
